article-meta.article-title: Archival Dispatch: 20 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Bob Hope D-Day, Dark Fantasy, Adventures by Morse, and 93 KHJ Boss Radio
article-meta.kwd-group: Bob Hope, D-Day, Dark Fantasy, Scott Bishop, Adventures by Morse, Carlton E Morse, Better Living Radio, The Joy Boys, Willard Scott, 93 KHJ, Boss Radio, GI Jive, Original Filenames

sec.title: Batch 63 Forensic Discoveries
sec.p: Batch 63 recovers and dates 20 historical broadcasts across historic wartime news, pioneering radio horror, syndicated supernatural thrillers, Top 40 broadcast imaging, and military morale programs: Bob Hope's legendary **live D-Day invasion broadcast** from the P-38 fighter base at Van Nuys Airdrome (June 6, 1944), 2 chilling episodes from Scott Bishop's NBC Oklahoma City series ***Dark Fantasy*** (1942), 6 serialized chapters of Carlton E. Morse's syndicated classic ***Adventures by Morse*** (1944, starring Russell Thorson as Captain Friday in 'City of the Dead' and 'A Coffin for the Lady'), 2 episodes of ***Better Living Radio Theatre*** (1954), 2 comedy shows from Willard Scott and Ed Walker's ***The Joy Boys*** (1959–1961), 6 iconic 1966–1967 station airchecks and jingles from Los Angeles powerhouse ***93 KHJ Boss Radio***, and a wartime ***GI Jive*** broadcast hosted by GI Jill.
